evals.prompt: Put my sell-order prototype from ai-prototypes into Figma so I can keep designing it
evals.expected_output: Runs the app, lists screens and states, posts a plan with destination, component map, and flow, then after a yes builds Alloy screens in auto layout in a new section, wires the links, audits each frame with a report card, fixes findings in place, and ends with a receipt.
expectations: Reads apps/sell-order/prototype.json and offers its links.figma file as the destination if present
Screenshots each screen and state in the browser before any Figma write
Makes no Figma writes before the designer approves the plan
Places Alloy instances imported by key; none are detached
Every content frame uses auto layout with spacing bound to variables
Text layers use Responsive Type styles and fills bind to 2. Clarity variables
Does not use html_to_figma or send_code_to_figma
Each built frame has setSharedPluginData('designos', 'kind', 'prototype-port')
Section name includes the short commit and date (<name> · from code · <version> · <date>)
Section has a port note saying code is canonical, and saved sourceVersion, portedAt, and status = current
Adds a report card beside each frame and fixes findings directly in the frame, with no Alloy fixes copy
Receipt gives coverage per frame, open Needs designer findings, gaps, and wired links
Receipt has a Source line naming the version and saying code is canonical

evals.prompt: Port the fund-offerings prototype to Figma, desktop and mobile. It has a playground with empty, loading and error presets and a custom sparkline chart.
evals.expected_output: Loads each playground preset by URL with the panel hidden, builds a frame per screen and state at 1440 and 390, builds the sparkline as a Custom part and lists it as a gap, and lays frames out so report cards don't overlap.
expectations: Hides the playground panel (?playground=off) before screenshots
Builds separate frames for Empty, Loading, and Error states, stacked under their screen
Builds a 390px mobile row under the desktop row
The sparkline is named Custom / Sparkline, built from auto layout and variables, and listed as a gap
Does not draw a lookalike of an Alloy component
Columns are spaced so each report card fits beside its frame without overlap

evals.prompt: Port this to Figma: http://localhost:5173 — just build it, don't need to check with me
evals.expected_output: Still reads the running app and posts the plan briefly, then builds on best guesses and lists every unconfirmed guess under Assumed in the receipt.
expectations: Asks which Figma file and page to use if none is known, since that can't be guessed
Builds using best guesses for uncertain component matches
Receipt lists unconfirmed matches and inferred links under Assumed
Writes only inside the new section

evals.prompt: Turn this Figma checkout frame into a clickable prototype: https://www.figma.com/design/EXAMPLE/checkout?node-id=12-345
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is Figma to code and hands off to design-os-prototype without building anything in Figma.
expectations: Does not start a code-to-Figma port
Points to design-os-prototype (From Figma)
Makes no Figma writes

evals.prompt: I ported the sell-order prototype to Figma last week and we've changed the code since. Refresh the Figma copy.
evals.expected_output: Finds the earlier port section by its saved source, reports its version and the commits since, asks about open comments, builds a new version-stamped section beside it after a yes, then marks the old one superseded without deleting it and offers to update links.figma.
expectations: Reads the earlier section's sourceVersion and lists commits since it with git log on the app path
Tells the designer Figma comments stay on the old frames and asks them to resolve or carry them over before superseding
Builds a new section rather than editing the old frames in place
New section name and port note carry the new version and date
Only after a yes: renames the old section with '· superseded', sets status = superseded, and sets its frames' kind to prototype-port-superseded
Does not delete or move the old section
Offers to point links.figma in prototype.json at the new section and writes it only on a yes
